answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Each agent must lock assets as a digital pigment of their identity to participate. A mass influx of fake accounts cannot shift the network tide because influence is bound to economic cost rather than identity count. Attackers must solve a cryptographic cipher to validate blocks, but they are deterred by the high capital expenditure required to gain majority consensus without forfeiting stake.
